prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a cat version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer: Draw a square reaction meme as a close-up of a plump, custard-yellow cartoon kitten caught mid-cackle. Give it the soft, rounded shape of a little toy dinosaur, with a tiny head that flows into a huge pear-shaped belly, then make it unmistakably feline with small triangular ears, a pink button nose, short whiskers, and little mitten paws. The kitten tips its head back, squeezes its eyes into two upside-down U’s, and opens its mouth so wide that the corners push its cheeks up. Show a deep burgundy mouth with a rounded pink tongue resting at the bottom. Its chin bunches into its chest and its paws hover over its belly as if it can barely breathe from laughing. Frame it from slightly below, cropping the belly at the bottom so the goofy face fills the frame. Use simple, softly lit 3D animation, smooth buttery-yellow surfaces, and a quiet, blurred background. No text or watermark.
